title: Charting the Landscape of African NLP: Mapping Progress and Shaping the Road Ahead

bias_targets.methodology: Systematic literature review identifying research papers that analyze gender bias in African NLP models and propose mitigation strategies, such as the use of gender-balanced occupational datasets.

Systematic literature review evaluating the lack of cultural context in translated datasets, which amplifies Western-centric concepts in QA tasks and perpetuates representational harms regarding African identities, lifestyles, and occupations in Visual Language Models (VLMs).
